subject: Request: short extension + alternative credit bucket for POC
messages:
From: Ian Carter <ian.carter@forgeway.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.legal@forgeway.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short extension + alternative credit bucket for POC

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday — the team at Forgeway is seeing promising alignment, but we need a little more runway to finish a couple of integration tests. Our original timebox ends next week and we wanted to ask if Redwood can do one of the following:

- 3-week extension on the current POC timebox (same environment), or
- Convert remaining trial days into a usage credit bucket we can consume over the next 60–90 days (preferred if possible).

We’ve attached our usage export through May 5 so you can see token patterns. Budget-wise we’re constrained: ideally any extension is cost-neutral (i.e., credits vs time) or comes with a modest discount. If helpful, we can do a partial payment upfront.

Please let us know what options work on your side and any paperwork you’d need (PO, SOW amendment, etc.).

Thanks — Ian
Forgeway | Director, Platform Engineering
[attachment: forgeway_poc_usage_may5.csv (csv)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ian Carter <ian.carter@forgeway.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + alternative credit bucket for POC

Ian — thanks for the context and the usage file. We can do either option; to move quickly here are two structured proposals we commonly use: 

Option A — Timebox extension
- 3-week extension at a flat rate of $9,500/week (covers reserved capacity & SRE support)
- Full payment on amended invoice or 60% upfront / 40% on completion upon request

Option B — Credit bucket (recommended for your usage profile)
- $30k credit bucket applied to token consumption over a 90-day window
- Staged billing: 50% upfront, 50% on conversion or expiration
- Cap on peak concurrency to prevent unexpected overage (we’ll propose a 1.5M tokens/day soft cap)

I’m copying Priyom (sales ops) to validate the math and Marcus (finance) for approval if we need to adjust discounting. I’ll draft a short amendment summary once you pick a preference.

Attaching a quick mock of proposed terms so you have something to circulate internally.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: proposed_extension_terms.pdf (pdf)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + alternative credit bucket for POC

Evelyn — quick pricing workup attached. Notes: 
- The $30k credit bucket aligns with the usage file if Forgeway stays within the current daily average; we modeled a 20% headroom.
- If they want any list-price discount beyond 12%, we need explicit finance signoff.
- Recommendation: offer a 10% partner-friendly discount on the bucket (so net ~$27k) but require staged payment to mitigate revenue risk.

I outlined two billing flows in the spreadsheet. If Marcus can greenlight 10% we can accept their 60/40 request; otherwise stick to 50/50.

[attachment: pricing_workup.xlsx (xlsx)]

—Priyom

From: Ian Carter <ian.carter@forgeway.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.legal@forgeway.ai>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + alternative credit bucket for POC

Thanks — Option B (credit bucket) sounds best for us. A couple requests before we sign: 

1) Can you do a 10% discount on the bucket? That helps us justify the additional spend to procurement.
2) We need a 90-day conversion window.
3) We’ll raise a PO, attached is our standard PO template — can you confirm billing contact and whether staged invoices are acceptable?

If you can confirm those items we’ll cut the PO and sign the amendment.

Ian
[attachment: PO_template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + alternative credit bucket for POC

Priyom / Evelyn — FYI from finance:
- We can approve up to a 12% discount for a short POC amendment without executive signoff. 10% is fine.
- Condition: staged payment must be front-loaded (we prefer 60% upfront / 40% on conversion) to protect revenue.
- Require updated SOW/amendment language that caps peak throughput (recommend 1.5M tokens/day) and limits auto-billing beyond the bucket without explicit written approval.
- Please include billing contact: billing@forgeway.ai and PO number on invoice; remit to Redwood Inference, Inc.

I’ve attached brief notes for the redline team. Once legal has the amendment we can route for signature.

[attachment: finance_approval_notes.txt (txt)]

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ian Carter <ian.carter@forgeway.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.legal@forgeway.ai>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 17:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + alternative credit bucket for POC

Ian — great, thanks for confirming. Finalizing terms below so everyone is aligned before I send the amendment for signature: 

Agreed terms (summary):
- Product: Redwood hosted inference (existing POC environment)
- Structure: Credit bucket (Option B)
- Face value: $30,000 with 10% partner discount applied (net $27,000)
- Billing: 60% upfront ($16,200) / 40% on conversion or at 90 days ($10,800)
- Consumption window: 90 days from amendment signature
- Usage cap: 1.5M tokens/day soft cap; any forecasted overage requires written approval prior to auto-billing
- Purchase order: please include PO number and billing contact (billing@forgeway.ai) on the invoice
- Deliverables: short SOW amendment + DocuSign-ready amendment (I’ll attach for signature)

Next steps: I’ll send the SOW amendment and DocuSign link within 2 business hours. Priyom will prepare the invoice stub. Marcus — thanks for the approval on the discount and payment cadence.

Ian — reply here if anything above needs to change; otherwise we’ll send the DocuSign.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: amendment_for_signing.docx (docx)]
